Class choose_tips_window

java.lang.Object
controller.choose_tips_window
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class choose_tips_window extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Choose Tips Window

Handles the logic for the choose tips window, including percentage buttons and custom tip input.
